config.codexExecutablePath: Absolute path to the Codex CLI, or auto. Workspace settings are ignored.
config.providers: Providers displayed by AI Limit Ledger.
config.providerVisibility: Controls whether the Dashboard shows active providers only, the resolver's automatic selection, or all supported providers.
config.providerVisibility.activeOnly: Show only active or previously enabled providers.
config.providerVisibility.allSupported: Show all supported providers in Active or Available sections.
config.providerOrder: Provider order shared by the Rich and Safe Dashboards. Unknown and duplicate IDs are ignored.
config.openOnStartup: Open the Dashboard once after startup. Opening it never starts a provider refresh.
config.showAvailableIntegrations: Show the Available Integrations section. Active providers remain visible when this is disabled.
config.insightsMode: Choose how provider usage insights are shown in both Dashboard renderers.
config.insightsMode.summary: Show the most important usage insights and keep the rest collapsed.
config.insightsMode.detailed: Show all safe usage insights in an expandable details section.
config.insightsMode.hidden: Hide usage insights while keeping quota cards and reset information.
config.dashboardMode: Selects the AI Limit Ledger dashboard renderer.
config.codexFallback: Unconditional Codex refresh interval used alongside the live account/rateLimits/updated notification. Lower values catch missed notifications sooner; higher values reduce background App Server calls.
config.claudeStatusLine: The refreshInterval (seconds) AI Limit Ledger asks Claude Code to use for its status-line invocations. Applied only when running Enable/Repair Claude Code Integration.
config.claudeAutoRepair: AI Limit Ledger can automatically repair its own Claude Code status-line integration when its wrapper is missing or outdated.
config.manualCooldown: Minimum time between manual AI Limit Ledger: Refresh invocations.
config.legacy: Deprecated compatibility setting retained for migration.
config.percentageMode: Textual percentage shown consistently in Dashboard, status bar and tooltip. Progress bars always represent remaining capacity.
config.language: Language for normalized UI text. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.language.en: Always use English for runtime UI.
config.language.tr: Always use Turkish for runtime UI.
config.timeFormat: Timestamp presentation for reset and freshness information.
config.tooltipDensity: Amount of cached information shown in provider tooltips.
config.warningThreshold: Remaining-capacity percentage at or below which the warning state is shown.
config.criticalThreshold: Remaining-capacity percentage at or below which the critical state is shown. It must be lower than the warning threshold.
config.notificationLevel: Automatic lifecycle notification policy. User-invoked consent, authentication and confirmation dialogs are unaffected.
config.recoveryActions: Show automatic error recovery actions. Manual Diagnose and Repair commands remain available when disabled.
config.loggingLevel: Minimum safe log level. Debug still redacts tokens, paths, identity, headers and provider payloads.
config.cacheMaxAge: How long non-sensitive last-known-good usage remains valid for display. It does not delete credential or cache files.
config.cacheExpired: Allow expired cached usage in the Dashboard with an explicit expired-data label. Expired values remain hidden from the status bar.
config.claudeOAuthEnabled: Experimental CLI-free Claude usage reads the existing credential read-only and never logs or stores the token.
config.claudeOAuthRefreshSeconds: Minimum seconds between experimental CLI-free Claude usage requests.
config.copilotCredits: User-configured monthly Copilot AI credits used when the plan is custom.
config.copilotRefresh: Minimum Copilot usage check interval in seconds.
config.copilotExecutablePath: Absolute machine-scoped path to the GitHub Copilot CLI, or auto to detect it.
config.copilotExperimental: Experimental, undocumented GitHub Copilot entitlement fallback. Tokens are never logged or included in diagnostics.
config.grokExecutablePath: Absolute machine-scoped path to the official Grok Build CLI.
config.grokRefresh: Minimum Grok usage check interval in seconds.
config.grokExperimental: Experimental Grok CLI-proxy billing fallback. Tokens are never logged or stored.
config.statusBarMode: Status bar display mode. Hidden removes all AI Limit Ledger status bar items.
config.statusBarMode.compact: Provider name and primary remaining percentage.
config.statusBarMode.detailed: Provider name, used/remaining values and reset/backoff summary.
config.statusBarMode.hidden: Hide AI Limit Ledger status bar items.
config.timeFormat.locale: Use the localized absolute date and time.
config.timeFormat.absolute: Use an absolute date and time.
config.timeFormat.both: Show absolute and compact relative time.
config.tooltipDensity.compact: Show only the primary status and reset summary.
config.tooltipDensity.detailed: Show windows, freshness, source and refresh details.
